question: Vo svetoznámom berlínskom techno klube Berghain vám vyhadzovači pri vstupe nič nezoberú, ale nalepia vám malú nálepku. Čo touto nálepkou prelepia?
topic: Vyhadzovači a pravidlá vstupu do klubov
source_excerpt: tiny circular stickers are placed on your phone's camera lens by security as soon as you walk through the club's security checkpoint.

extra.why_interesting: Players expect a strict club to confiscate things or search bags. Instead the bouncers take nothing and just tape over your phone camera. The player can reason it out: what would a club want to keep secret?
extra.verification_notes: Multiple sources confirm Berghain security places a sticker over guests' phone camera lenses at entry rather than confiscating phones (https://www.technoairlines.com/blog/how-to-get-into-berghain).

explanation: Vnútri platí prísny zákaz fotografovania. Klub tak chráni súkromie hostí a dodnes o ňom kolujú skôr legendy než fotky.
